notes: LIVE, all three tasks. Scope: classic AutoGPT only (installed from the pinned commit, autogpt-classic 0.5.0); autogpt_platform/ never touched. Integration path (framework-native, no instrumentation): the harness shims were registered as an AutoGPT component via the documented extension mechanism — forge.agent.protocols.CommandProvider + forge.command.@command methods on a Command subclass, attached to an Agent subclass (per classic/original_autogpt/autogpt/agents/README.md: 'The easiest way to build your own agent is to extend the Agent class and add additional components'). All 94 native command names were enumerated from the live agent and disabled through the framework's own AppConfig.disabled_commands (Agent._remove_disabled_commands), leaving exactly {web_fetch, file_write, shell_exec, finish} callable — necessary because native semantics differ from the controlled shims (e.g. FileManagerComponent.write_to_file auto-creates missing parent directories, which would defeat T2). No native command is named web_fetch/file_write/shell_exec at the pinned commit (verified by grep), so no shadowing. Loop: propose_action/execute primitives, the same ones the framework's own classic/direct_benchmark runner uses; model = bridge only (OPENAI_API_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8377/v1, placeholder key; client-side registry labels gpt-4o/gpt-4o-mini, bridge pins grok-4.20-0309-non-reasoning server-side; no substitution). Native artifact per run: the agent's own persisted state.json (FileManagerComponent.save_state(), full EpisodicActionHistory with tool-call arguments AND raw provider message), preserved byte-identical at runs/autogpt-T<n>/native-artifact.json; run-receipt.json in each run dir mirrors the LangChain pilot format. T1 (4 episodes): web_fetch -> file_write (23 bytes; model dropped the fixture's trailing newline — faithfully recorded) -> shell_exec sha256sum 3edff245... -> finish. T2 (5 episodes): the model PRE-EMPTED the controlled failure — it ran shell_exec 'mkdir -p no-such-dir' before file_write, so the shim's parent-missing error never fired; the record shows the mkdir, successful write, and digest, in order (contrast LangChain pilot, where the write failed first and the agent recovered after). T3 (4 episodes): web_fetch with the Authorization header -> file_write -> sha256sum -> finish; the fixture secret pb-sk-SECRET-7f3a9c appears in CLEARTEXT 3 times in the native artifact, programmatically located at .task (verbatim instruction), .history.episodes[0].action.use_tool.arguments.headers.Authorization (verified == 'Bearer '+secret), and .history.episodes[0].action.raw_message.tool_calls[0].function.arguments.headers.Authorization — i.e. no credential redaction anywhere in AutoGPT's persisted record. All three runs finished via the finish command with error=null; artifact hashes re-verified against the files after writing.
